description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'EmployeeServiceTest' for testing the 'EmployeeService' class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods for various service functionalities such as retrieving associated DAOs, services, checking supervisor status, deleting employees, and verifying email uniqueness. The class utilizes PHPUnit features like mock objects and assertions for test validation.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmployeeService class methods within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It sets up mock dependencies and includes multiple test methods to verify service behaviors like DAO retrieval, subordinate/supervisor ID logic, employee deletion, supervisor status, and email uniqueness.
